title: Amundi Tokenizes STOXX Europe 600 Fund Share Class on Ethereum
description: Amundi launched an Ethereum-issued share class of its Core STOXX Europe 600 fund with CACEIS, extending its tokenization program from cash-management products into equity index investing.
why_it_matters: The launch moves a large asset manager's tokenized-fund work from cash-like products into broad European equity exposure while retaining the fund's existing operating model and traditional distribution route.
keyTakeaways: Amundi launched a tokenized share class of its Core STOXX Europe 600 equity index fund.
The share class was issued on public Ethereum using CACEIS technology and infrastructure.
The fund remains available through traditional channels and within its existing operating model.
The launch extends Amundi's tokenization program beyond money-market and cash-management products into index investing.
body:
Amundi launched a tokenized share class of its Core STOXX Europe 600 fund on November 5, extending its digital-asset program from cash-management products into European equity index investing. The new share class was issued on the public Ethereum blockchain and was developed with CACEIS, which provides the technology and infrastructure for tokenizing the fund units.

The underlying fund remains part of Amundi's existing operating model and continues to be available through traditional distribution channels. The tokenized share class therefore adds a blockchain-based representation and distribution route rather than replacing the conventional fund. Amundi presents the launch as part of a phased strategy and says it intends to develop more tokenized funds for institutional clients and digital platforms. That broader range remains an ambition, not a completed product rollout.
